info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Equipment Maintenance Management API
info.description: The Equipment Maintenance Management API facilitates the maintenance and updates of banking facilities' equipment. Through its PATCH operation, users can modify existing equipment records to ensure optimal performance and compliance. This API is essential for maintenance teams, operations managers, and system integrators who seek to maintain equipment reliability and reduce downtime. Typical use cases include updating maintenance schedules, recording repairs, and tracking equipment status.

patch.summary: Update equipment maintenance details for a specific facility.
patch.description: This API endpoint allows users to update the maintenance information for a specific piece of equipment associated with the facility identified by RES-100045. Ensure to provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully update the records.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating maintenance operations on facility equipment identified by RES-100045. This includes any relevant changes to the equipment's maintenance records or operational status.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource was updated.
